querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      est_dt,
                                      est_report_dt,
                                      net_profit,
                                      est_eps,
                                      est_pe,
                                      est_peg,
                                      est_pb,
                                      est_roe,
                                      est_oper_revenue,
                                      est_cfps,
                                      est_dps,
                                      est_bps,
                                      est_ebit,
                                      est_ebitda,
                                      est_total_profit,
                                      est_oper_profit,
                                      est_oper_cost,
                                      est_shr,
                                      type1,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_aindexconsensusdata.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.aindexconsensusdata WHERE est_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
